summary.headline: Signatureglobal H1 FY27 sales of about 1.6 million sq ft, roughly 40% of the ₹10,000 crore annual target, with H2 launches planned.
summary.overview: Management said H1 FY27 sales reached about 1.6 million sq ft, about 40% of the annual sales target, driven by one launch in Sector 71 Gurugram. Operating cash flow surplus was about ₹4.8 billion for the half, roughly 28% of collections, and management expects collections to be stronger in H2. Business development was active, with about 8.4 million sq ft of net land addition, including Faruknagar (194 acres, mostly collaboration) and a 31-acre Sohna addition. Q2 completions were about ₹14 billion, with Q2 margin at about 18% versus 13% for the half. Management reiterated guidance on launches, sales, collections and completions despite a slower collections quarter.

financial_highlights.metric: H1 sales as share of annual sales target

financial_highlights.change: vs ₹970 crore in H1 FY26 per analyst

segments.name: Residential sales
segments.commentary: About 1.6 million sq ft sold in H1 FY27 from a single launch in Sector 71 Gurugram; management said the annual sales target of about ₹100 billion is unchanged.

segments.name: Land / business development
segments.commentary: About 8.4 million sq ft net added. Faruknagar Gurugram parcel totals 194 acres (about 25 acres bought, 169 acres via collaboration). Sohna added about 31 acres (~10 million sq ft potential) via collaboration.

segments.name: Mixed-use JV (RMV Group, Southern Peripheral Road)
segments.commentary: About 5.6 million sq ft mixed-use project; transaction completed by March, design with KPF, no launch or construction start yet.

guidance_outlook: Annual sales target of about ₹100 billion maintained; management said H1 delivered about 40% and more launches are planned in H2.
Completions guidance of about ₹50 billion for FY27 reiterated.
Operating cash flow guidance of about ₹15 billion for the current year reiterated, with collections expected to pick up in H2.
Construction cost escalation seen in the late single digits; management does not expect double-digit escalation this year.

Next launches: a 2+ million sq ft Sector 71 project (last launch in May) at advanced pre-launch stage, an iconic single tower on Dwarka Expressway, and a further phase pending approvals in Sohna. Timing not specified precisely.
Business development expected to continue in H2, with land spend up to about the level of operating cash flow (~₹15 billion).
capex_capacity: Launch pipeline: 2+ million sq ft Sector 71 Gurugram launch at advanced pre-launch stage; additional Dwarka Expressway single-tower launch and Sohna phase pending approvals.
Portfolio under development about 23 million sq ft, to be delivered over the next two years.
Recently launched portfolio GDV about ₹350 billion (described as 'close to 35 or 350 odd billion').
Construction planned around a 10-month working window, with stock-up assumed to offset NGT-related construction bans.
Plotted developments in Sohna and City of Colors nearing completion, with completion approvals expected within this year.
demand_pricing: Management described the market as steady despite macro headwinds; real estate seen as an inflation hedge.
Secondary resale prices above primary prices in middle-income housing due to limited secondary supply since 2022, per management.
Industry context cited: top-7 city sales above 100,000 units in the quarter, new launches up 18%, NCR fastest price rise.
Brokerage slabs for sales typically 3–5%; Lamborghini-branded project brokerage expected at the lower end.
Collections have run at about ₹10 billion per quarter over the last 8–10 quarters, with last quarter below trend.

qa_highlights.question: What are the H2 launches (sizes, timing) and expected sales pace, and the H1 bookings level?
qa_highlights.answer: Next Sector 71 launch of 2+ million sq ft at advanced pre-launch, last launch was May; Dwarka Expressway single iconic tower soon; Sohna phase pending approvals. Management expects business development to continue, with land additions up to about operating cash flow (>₹15 billion).

qa_highlights.question: Why did sales slow in the quarter and what is the inventory left in recent launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it targeted about 40% of the annual sales target in H1 and is not heavy on the year. Inventory in recent launches was not quantified in the call; resale in Delhi above ₹100 crore is a separate, higher-ticket segment.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of NGT construction bans on execution and sales guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called it a recurring issue; planning assumes about 10 working months per year with stock-up to absorb bans. Sales guidance described as in line; markets steady.

qa_highlights.question: Why did construction cost incurred fall (₹880 crore in H1 vs ₹970 crore) and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Lower spend due to plotted developments in Sohna and City of Colors nearing completion, which need little construction spend. Construction cost escalation seen in the late single digits, not double digits this year.

qa_highlights.question: Why did the Lamborghini project launch value change from ~₹44 billion to ~₹43 billion?
qa_highlights.answer: Management described the change as minor and did not indicate a price revision; no specific reason was given in the call.

risks_watch: Collections and OCF guidance (~₹15 billion) depend on H2 collections; management acknowledged H2 work is needed and H1 collections were lower in the latest quarter.
Recurring NGT-related construction bans could disrupt execution and material availability.
Sales target of ~₹100 billion requires the H2 launches (Sector 71, Dwarka Expressway, Sohna) to land on time; timing was not firmly stated.
Faruknagar and Southern Peripheral Road projects remain at early stage with approvals pending; no launch timing given.
Construction spend fell year on year; cost escalation remains in the late single digits.
summary.management_tone: Confident on sales, collections and completions guidance, but vague on exact launch timing and specific reasons for lower collections and construction spend; several answers were brief or deferred.

adds.what: 2+ million sq ft Sector 71 Gurugram launch (advanced pre-launch)

growth.why: Management held FY27 pre-sales guidance at ₹100 bn (H1 ~40% achieved, ~1.6 mn sq ft from one Sector 71 launch) and completions at ~₹50 bn, with OCF guided above ₹15 bn; backing is partial, relying on H2 launches (2+ mn sq ft Sector 71, Dwarka Expressway, Sohna) with timing not precisely specified and collections expected to pick up in H2.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 completion margin was about 18% versus 13% for H1, but the brief gives no full-year margin guidance and the Q2 uplift may not persist.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Portfolio under development is about 23 million sq ft to be delivered over two years, and a 2+ million sq ft Sector 71 launch is at advanced pre-launch, with Dwarka Expressway and Sohna phases also planned.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management kept the ₹100 bn annual sales target, H1 delivered about 40% (~1.6 mn sq ft from one launch), and more launches are planned in H2, though timing is not firm.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Business development added about 8.4 mn sq ft net in H1 with land spend guided to about ₹15 bn in H2, and the Faruknagar and Sohna parcels are being developed through collaborations.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Pre-sales (₹100 bn), completions (~₹50 bn) and OCF (>₹15 bn) guidance were all held rather than raised, and H1 sales are only ~40% of target.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H2 collections must recover from a below-trend quarter (collections run ~₹10 bn/quarter over 8-10 quarters), and the sales target depends on H2 launches whose timing was not firmly stated.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Sector 71 2+ mn sq ft project is at advanced pre-launch (last launch in May), an iconic Dwarka Expressway single tower is coming soon, and a Sohna phase is pending approvals.

rows.label: H2 sales pace to reach ₹100 bn target
rows.why: H1 sales were about 40% of the ₹100 bn target from one launch, so H2 needs the Sector 71, Dwarka Expressway and Sohna launches to land on time.

rows.label: H2 collections pickup to deliver OCF above ₹15 bn
rows.why: H1 OCF surplus was about ₹4.8 bn (~28% of collections), and management said OCF will cross ₹15 bn for the year but acknowledged H2 collections need to improve.

rows.label: Construction cost escalation kept in late single digits
rows.why: Management does not expect double-digit escalation this year, and construction spend fell to ₹880 cr in H1 from ₹970 cr, helped by plotted developments needing little spend.

tone.note: Management was confident on holding sales (₹100 bn), completions (~₹50 bn) and OCF (>₹15 bn) guidance and on land additions, but was vague on launch timing and on the reasons for lower collections and construction spend; analysts pressed on the H2 sales pace and the slower collections quarter.
